message.reasoning:
I need to make a decision for the current Monopoly turn.

I have $1032 and am on B_O_RAILROAD. My properties include ST_CHARLES_PLACE, STATES_AVENUE, VIRGINIA_AVENUE, ST_JAMES_PLACE, TENNESSEE_AVENUE, and NEW_YORK_AVENUE with 2–4 houses each. I also hold two get-out-of-jail cards. Opponent p2 has $395 and owns red properties with 3–4 houses, plus unmortgaged Pacific and Penn.

p3 is bankrupt. p4 has $86 and owns unmortgaged Mediterranean and Marvin Gardens; they just paid me $750 in rent on St James. I am considering building a hotel on the reds to empty the bank, but I will first upgrade Virginia Avenue from two to three houses.

The bank currently holds three houses. I will add one house each to States and St Charles, then upgrade Virginia Avenue to four houses. This keeps the pink properties within one house of each other and empties the bank. I will not unmortgage Baltic, Vermont, Connecticut, or Short Line. I also will not trade away any get-out-of-jail cards.

I will not build on St James, Tennessee, or New York Avenue because they already have four houses. A hotel there would return four houses to the bank and let p2 buy them. I will keep building evenly on St Charles and States.

Virginia Avenue is at three houses while the other pinks are at two, so I cannot build there yet. I will add one house each to States and St Charles for $200 total, then upgrade Virginia to four houses for another $100. That leaves me with $732 in cash. I am checking whether the game allows multiple house builds in a single action.

I confirmed that multiple house builds can be submitted in a single action. I am now verifying whether the engine validates the plan as a sequence of steps or as a final state, since adding one house each to States and St Charles would temporarily leave Virginia at three houses while the other two reach four.

I will apply the three house builds in sequence to keep the even-building rule valid at every step. This leaves the bank with zero houses, preventing p2 from building further.

I will not build only two houses to save cash. I need to empty the bank completely so p2 cannot buy houses with their $395.

I will build all three houses. Leaving one would let p2 upgrade a red property to four houses, but taking all three prevents them from doing so.
